name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q01 - Peak voltage of standard household line supply

questiontext.text:
The electric mains voltage supplied to a household is specified as \(220\text{ V}\) ac. What is the peak (amplitude) voltage of this supply?

एक घर में आपूर्ति की जाने वाली विद्युत मेंस वोल्टता \(220\text{ V}\) ac निर्दिष्ट है। इस आपूर्ति की शिखर (आयाम) वोल्टता क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The specified alternating voltage is the root-mean-square value, \(V = 220\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For a sinusoidal alternating voltage, the peak voltage \(v_m\) is related to the rms voltage \(V\) by:
\[v_m = \sqrt{2} V\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Using \(\sqrt{2} \approx 1.414\):
\[v_m = 1.414 \times 220\text{ V} = 311.08\text{ V} \approx 311\text{ V}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The peak voltage is \(311\text{ V}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
निर्दिष्ट वोल्टता वर्ग-माध्य-मूल मान है, \(V = 220\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: संबंधित सूत्र
शिखर वोल्टता और rms वोल्टता में संबंध:
\[v_m = \sqrt{2} V\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[v_m = 1.414 \times 220\text{ V} \approx 311\text{ V}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
शिखर वोल्टता \(311\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q02 - RMS voltage calculation from peak source voltage

questiontext.text:
The peak voltage of an alternating current supply is measured to be \(300\text{ V}\). What is the root mean square (rms) voltage of this supply?

एक प्रत्यावर्ती धारा आपूर्ति की शिखर वोल्टता \(300\text{ V}\) मापी जाती है। इस आपूर्ति की वर्ग-माध्य-मूल (rms) वोल्टता क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Peak voltage \(v_m = 300\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The rms voltage \(V\) of a sinusoidal source is given by:
\[V = \frac{v_m}{\sqrt{2}} = 0.7071 v_m\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[V = \frac{300\text{ V}}{1.4142} \approx 212.13\text{ V} \approx 212.1\text{ V}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The calculated rms voltage is \(212.1\text{ V}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
शिखर वोल्टता \(v_m = 300\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[V = \frac{v_m}{\sqrt{2}}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[V = \frac{300}{1.4142} \approx 212.1\text{ V}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
rms वोल्टता \(212.1\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q03 - Peak current calculation from given rms current

questiontext.text:
The rms value of current in an ac circuit is \(10\text{ A}\). What is the peak current (amplitude) in the circuit?

एक ac परिपथ में धारा का rms मान \(10\text{ A}\) है। परिपथ में शिखर धारा (आयाम) क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
RMS current \(I = 10\text{ A}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For sinusoidal alternating current:
\[i_m = \sqrt{2} I\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[i_m = 1.414 \times 10\text{ A} = 14.14\text{ A} \approx 14.1\text{ A}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The peak current is \(14.1\text{ A}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
rms धारा \(I = 10\text{ A}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[i_m = \sqrt{2} I\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[i_m = 1.414 \times 10\text{ A} \approx 14.1\text{ A}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
शिखर धारा \(14.1\text{ A}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q04 - Net power absorbed by pure inductor over cycle

questiontext.text:
A \(44\text{ mH}\) inductor is connected to a \(220\text{ V}\), \(50\text{ Hz}\) ac supply. What is the net power absorbed by the inductor over a complete cycle?

एक \(44\text{ mH}\) का प्रेरक \(220\text{ V}\), \(50\text{ Hz}\) की ac आपूर्ति से जुड़ा है। एक पूर्ण चक्र में प्रेरक द्वारा अवशोषित कुल विद्युत शक्ति कितनी है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Inductance \(L = 44\text{ mH}\), supply voltage \(V = 220\text{ V}\), frequency \(\nu = 50\text{ Hz}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The average power over a complete cycle in an ac circuit is given by:
\[P = V I \cos\phi\]
In an ideal pure inductor, the current lags the voltage by \(\phi = \frac{\pi}{2}\) radians (\(90^\circ\)), so \(\cos\phi = \cos 90^\circ = 0\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[P = V I \cos 90^\circ = V I \times 0 = 0\text{ W}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The net power absorbed by a pure inductor over a full cycle is exactly \(0\text{ W}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(L = 44\text{ mH}\), \(V = 220\text{ V}\), \(\nu = 50\text{ Hz}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
औसत शक्ति \(P = V I \cos\phi\)। शुद्ध प्रेरक के लिए धारा वोल्टता से \(90^\circ\) पश्चगामी होती है, अतः \(\phi = 90^\circ\) तथा \(\cos\phi = 0\)।

चरण 3: गणना
\[P = V I \times 0 = 0\text{ W}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
पूर्ण चक्र में शुद्ध प्रेरक द्वारा अवशोषित कुल शक्ति \(0\text{ W}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q05 - Net power absorbed by pure capacitor over cycle

questiontext.text:
A \(60\,\mu\text{F}\) capacitor is connected to a \(110\text{ V}\), \(60\text{ Hz}\) ac supply. What is the net power absorbed by the capacitor over one complete cycle?

एक \(60\,\mu\text{F}\) का संधारित्र \(110\text{ V}\), \(60\text{ Hz}\) की ac आपूर्ति से जुड़ा है। एक पूर्ण चक्र में संधारित्र द्वारा अवशोषित कुल शक्ति कितनी है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Capacitor \(C = 60\,\mu\text{F}\), \(V = 110\text{ V}\), \(\nu = 60\text{ Hz}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For an ideal pure capacitor, the alternating current leads the applied voltage by \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) radians (\(90^\circ\)). The power factor is:
\[\cos\phi = \cos(-90^\circ) = 0\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
The average power over a complete cycle is:
\[P = V I \cos\phi = V I \times 0 = 0\text{ W}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The net power absorbed over a complete cycle is \(0\text{ W}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(C = 60\,\mu\text{F}\), \(V = 110\text{ V}\), \(\nu = 60\text{ Hz}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
शुद्ध संधारित्र के लिए धारा वोल्टता से \(90^\circ\) अग्रगामी होती है। शक्ति गुणांक \(\cos\phi = \cos 90^\circ = 0\)।

चरण 3: गणना
\[P = V I \cos 90^\circ = 0\text{ W}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
संधारित्र द्वारा एक पूर्ण चक्र में अवशोषित कुल शक्ति \(0\text{ W}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q06 - Amplitude of voltage across two hundred forty volt outlet

questiontext.text:
An ac voltage across an electric outlet is rated as \(240\text{ V}\) rms. What is the amplitude of the alternating voltage?

एक विद्युत आउटलेट पर ac वोल्टता \(240\text{ V}\) rms निर्धारित है। इस प्रत्यावर्ती वोल्टता का आयाम क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
RMS voltage \(V = 240\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The amplitude (peak value) \(v_m\) is related to the rms value \(V\) by:
\[v_m = \sqrt{2} V\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[v_m = 1.4142 \times 240\text{ V} \approx 339.4\text{ V}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The amplitude of the voltage is \(339.4\text{ V}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
rms वोल्टता \(V = 240\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[v_m = \sqrt{2} V\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[v_m = 1.4142 \times 240 \approx 339.4\text{ V}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
वोल्टता का आयाम \(339.4\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q07 - Numerical ratio of peak to rms alternating current

questiontext.text:
For a purely sinusoidal alternating current, what is the exact numerical ratio of its peak value to its root mean square value (\(i_m / I\))?

एक विशुद्ध ज्यावक्रीय प्रत्यावर्ती धारा के लिए, इसके शिखर मान तथा इसके वर्ग-माध्य-मूल मान का संख्यात्मक अनुपात (\(i_m / I\)) क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Current waveform: sinusoidal alternating current \(i = i_m \sin\omega t\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The relationship between peak current \(i_m\) and rms current \(I\) is:
\[I = \frac{i_m}{\sqrt{2}}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Taking the ratio:
\[\frac{i_m}{I} = \sqrt{2} \approx 1.414\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The ratio is \(\sqrt{2} \approx 1.414\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
ज्यावक्रीय प्रत्यावर्ती धारा \(i = i_m \sin\omega t\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[I = \frac{i_m}{\sqrt{2}}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[\frac{i_m}{I} = \sqrt{2} \approx 1.414\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
अनुपात \(\sqrt{2} \approx 1.414\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q08 - Filament resistance calculation of hundred watt rated bulb

questiontext.text:
A light bulb is rated at \(100\text{ W}\) for a \(220\text{ V}\) supply. What is the resistance of the bulb filament?

एक विद्युत बल्ब \(220\text{ V}\) आपूर्ति पर \(100\text{ W}\) अनुमत है। बल्ब के तंतु का प्रतिरोध क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Rated power \(P = 100\text{ W}\); Rated rms voltage \(V = 220\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The relationship between power, rms voltage, and resistance is:
\[P = \frac{V^2}{R} \implies R = \frac{V^2}{P}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[R = \frac{(220\text{ V})^2}{100\text{ W}} = \frac{48400}{100}\,\Omega = 484\,\Omega\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The resistance of the bulb is \(484\,\Omega\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
शक्ति \(P = 100\text{ W}\), वोल्टता \(V = 220\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[R = \frac{V^2}{P}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[R = \frac{(220)^2}{100} = \frac{48400}{100} = 484\,\Omega\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
बल्ब का प्रतिरोध \(484\,\Omega\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q09 - RMS current drawn by rated incandescent light bulb

questiontext.text:
A light bulb is rated at \(100\text{ W}\) for a \(220\text{ V}\) ac supply. What is the rms current flowing through the bulb when connected to this supply?

एक विद्युत बल्ब \(220\text{ V}\) ac आपूर्ति पर \(100\text{ W}\) अनुमत है। इस आपूर्ति से जुड़े होने पर बल्ब से प्रवाहित rms धारा क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Power \(P = 100\text{ W}\); Voltage \(V = 220\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For a purely resistive load, the average power is given by:
\[P = V I \implies I = \frac{P}{V}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[I = \frac{100\text{ W}}{220\text{ V}} = \frac{5}{11}\text{ A} \approx 0.4545\text{ A} \approx 0.45\text{ A}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The rms current drawn by the bulb is \(0.45\text{ A}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(P = 100\text{ W}\), \(V = 220\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[I = \frac{P}{V}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[I = \frac{100}{220} = \frac{5}{11}\text{ A} \approx 0.45\text{ A}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
बल्ब से प्रवाहित rms धारा \(0.45\text{ A}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q10 - Peak current calculation for rated light bulb

questiontext.text:
A light bulb is rated at \(100\text{ W}\) for a \(220\text{ V}\) ac supply. What is the peak current (amplitude) through the bulb?

एक विद्युत बल्ब \(220\text{ V}\) ac आपूर्ति पर \(100\text{ W}\) अनुमत है। बल्ब से प्रवाहित शिखर धारा (आयाम) क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
RMS current \(I = \frac{100}{220}\text{ A} \approx 0.4545\text{ A}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The peak current \(i_m\) is related to the rms current \(I\) by:
\[i_m = \sqrt{2} I\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[i_m = 1.414 \times 0.4545\text{ A} \approx 0.6427\text{ A} \approx 0.64\text{ A}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The peak current through the bulb is \(0.64\text{ A}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(I = \frac{100}{220} \approx 0.455\text{ A}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[i_m = \sqrt{2} I\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[i_m = 1.414 \times 0.4545 \approx 0.64\text{ A}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
बल्ब में शिखर धारा \(0.64\text{ A}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q11 - RMS current in pure resistor connected to AC

questiontext.text:
A \(100\,\Omega\) resistor is connected to a \(220\text{ V}\), \(50\text{ Hz}\) ac supply. What is the rms value of current in the circuit?

एक \(100\,\Omega\) का प्रतिरोधक \(220\text{ V}\), \(50\text{ Hz}\) की ac आपूर्ति से जुड़ा है। परिपथ में धारा का rms मान क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Resistance \(R = 100\,\Omega\); RMS voltage \(V = 220\text{ V}\); Frequency \(\nu = 50\text{ Hz}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For a purely resistive ac circuit, Ohm's law applies directly to rms values:
\[I = \frac{V}{R}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[I = \frac{220\text{ V}}{100\,\Omega} = 2.20\text{ A}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The rms current in the circuit is \(2.20\text{ A}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(R = 100\,\Omega\), \(V = 220\text{ V}\), \(\nu = 50\text{ Hz}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[I = \frac{V}{R}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[I = \frac{220}{100} = 2.20\text{ A}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
परिपथ में धारा का rms मान \(2.20\text{ A}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q12 - Net power consumed by resistor over full cycle

questiontext.text:
A \(100\,\Omega\) resistor is connected to a \(220\text{ V}\), \(50\text{ Hz}\) ac line. What is the net electrical power consumed over a full cycle?

एक \(100\,\Omega\) का प्रतिरोधक \(220\text{ V}\), \(50\text{ Hz}\) की ac लाइन से जुड़ा है। एक पूर्ण चक्र में उपभुक्त कुल विद्युत शक्ति क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(R = 100\,\Omega\), \(V = 220\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The average power consumed by a resistor in an ac circuit is:
\[P = \frac{V^2}{R} = I^2 R\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[P = \frac{(220\text{ V})^2}{100\,\Omega} = \frac{48400}{100}\text{ W} = 484\text{ W}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The net power consumed over a full cycle is \(484\text{ W}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(R = 100\,\Omega\), \(V = 220\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[P = \frac{V^2}{R}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[P = \frac{(220)^2}{100} = 484\text{ W}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
उपभुक्त कुल विद्युत शक्ति \(484\text{ W}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q13 - Peak current calculation in pure resistive circuit

questiontext.text:
A pure resistor of \(100\,\Omega\) is connected to a \(220\text{ V}\), \(50\text{ Hz}\) ac source. What is the peak (maximum) current flowing through the resistor?

\(100\,\Omega\) का एक शुद्ध प्रतिरोधक \(220\text{ V}\), \(50\text{ Hz}\) के ac स्रोत से जुड़ा है। प्रतिरोधक से प्रवाहित शिखर (अधिकतम) धारा क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Resistance \(R = 100\,\Omega\); RMS voltage \(V = 220\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
First, calculate peak voltage:
\[v_m = \sqrt{2} V\]
Then peak current is given by Ohm's law:
\[i_m = \frac{v_m}{R} = \sqrt{2} \frac{V}{R}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[v_m = 1.4142 \times 220\text{ V} \approx 311.13\text{ V}\]
\[i_m = \frac{311.13\text{ V}}{100\,\Omega} = 3.111\text{ A} \approx 3.11\text{ A}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The peak current is \(3.11\text{ A}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(R = 100\,\Omega\), \(V = 220\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[i_m = \frac{\sqrt{2} V}{R}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[i_m = \frac{1.414 \times 220}{100} = \frac{311.1}{100} \approx 3.11\text{ A}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
शिखर धारा \(3.11\text{ A}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q14 - Inductive reactance of twenty-five millihenry coil

questiontext.text:
An inductor of self-inductance \(25.0\text{ mH}\) is connected across a \(220\text{ V}\), \(50.0\text{ Hz}\) ac line. What is the inductive reactance of the coil?

\(25.0\text{ mH}\) स्व-प्रेरकत्व की एक कुंडली \(220\text{ V}\), \(50.0\text{ Hz}\) की ac लाइन के सिरों से जुड़ी है। कुंडली का प्रेरकीय प्रतिघात क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Inductance \(L = 25.0 ext{ mH} = 25.0 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H}\); Frequency \( u = 50.0 ext{ Hz}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The inductive reactance \(X_L\) is given by:
\[X_L = \omega L = 2\pi u L\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[X_L = 2 imes 3.1416 imes 50.0 ext{ s}^{-1} imes (25.0 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H})\]
\[X_L = 314.16 imes 0.0250\,\Omega = 7.854\,\Omega \approx 7.85\,\Omega\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The inductive reactance of the coil is \(7.85\,\Omega\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(L = 25.0 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H}\), \( u = 50.0 ext{ Hz}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[X_L = 2\pi u L\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[X_L = 2 imes 3.1416 imes 50.0 imes 0.0250 = 314.16 imes 0.0250 \approx 7.85\,\Omega\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
प्रेरकीय प्रतिघात \(7.85\,\Omega\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q15 - RMS current in twenty-five millihenry pure inductor

questiontext.text:
A pure inductor of \(25.0\text{ mH}\) is connected to a \(220\text{ V}\), \(50.0\text{ Hz}\) source. What is the rms value of the alternating current in the circuit?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(L = 25.0 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H}\); \(V = 220 ext{ V}\); \( u = 50.0 ext{ Hz}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The inductive reactance is \(X_L = 2\pi u L\).
The rms current in a pure inductor is given by:
\[I = rac{V}{X_L}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[X_L = 2 imes 3.1416 imes 50.0 imes 25.0 imes 10^{-3} \approx 7.854\,\Omega\]
\[I = rac{220 ext{ V}}{7.854\,\Omega} \approx 28.01 ext{ A} \approx 28 ext{ A}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The rms current in the inductor is \(28 ext{ A}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(L = 25.0 ext{ mH}\), \(V = 220 ext{ V}\), \( u = 50.0 ext{ Hz}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[X_L = 2\pi u L, \quad I = rac{V}{X_L}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[X_L \approx 7.85\,\Omega\]
\[I = rac{220}{7.85} \approx 28 ext{ A}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q20 - Peak current through fifteen microfarad capacitor

A \(15.0\,\mu\text{F}\) capacitor is connected to a \(220\text{ V}\), \(50.0\text{ Hz}\) source. If the rms current in the circuit is \(1.04\text{ A}\), what is the peak current amplitude?

चरण 3: गणना

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q23 - Free oscillation angular frequency of LC circuit

questiontext.text:
A charged \(30.0\,\mu\text{F}\) capacitor is connected across a \(27.0\text{ mH}\) inductor to form an ideal \(LC\) circuit. What is the angular frequency of free oscillations of this circuit?

एक आवेशित \(30.0\,\mu\text{F}\) संधारित्र को एक आदर्श \(LC\) परिपथ बनाने के लिए \(27.0\text{ mH}\) के प्रेरक से जोड़ा गया है। इस परिपथ के मुक्त दोलनों की कोणीय आवृत्ति क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(C = 30.0\,\mu\text{F} = 30.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ F}\); \(L = 27.0\text{ mH} = 27.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ H}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The angular frequency of free electrical oscillations in an \(LC\) circuit is:
\[\omega_0 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[LC = (27.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ H}) \times (30.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ F}) = 810 \times 10^{-9}\text{ s}^2 = 81.0 \times 10^{-8}\text{ s}^2\]
\[\sqrt{LC} = 9.00 \times 10^{-4}\text{ s}\]
\[\omega_0 = \frac{1}{9.00 \times 10^{-4}\text{ s}} = \frac{10000}{9}\text{ rad/s} \approx 1.111 \times 10^3\text{ rad/s} \approx 1.11 \times 10^3\text{ rad/s}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The angular frequency is \(1.11 \times 10^3\text{ rad/s}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(C = 30.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ F}\), \(L = 27.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ H}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[\omega_0 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[LC = 81 \times 10^{-8}\text{ s}^2 \implies \sqrt{LC} = 9 \times 10^{-4}\text{ s}\]
\[\omega_0 = \frac{1}{9 \times 10^{-4}} \approx 1.11 \times 10^3\text{ rad/s}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
मुक्त दोलनों की कोणीय आवृत्ति \(1.11 \times 10^3\text{ rad/s}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q24 - Natural frequency in hertz of LC oscillator

questiontext.text:
A \(30.0\,\mu\text{F}\) capacitor is connected across a \(27.0\text{ mH}\) inductor. What is the natural linear frequency of free oscillations in hertz?

एक \(30.0\,\mu\text{F}\) का संधारित्र \(27.0\text{ mH}\) के प्रेरक से जुड़ा है। हर्ट्ज़ में मुक्त दोलनों की प्राकृतिक रैखिक आवृत्ति क्या है?

\(L = 27.0 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H}\); \(C = 30.0 imes 10^{-6} ext{ F}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The linear frequency \( u\) is given by:
\[ u = rac{\omega_0}{2\pi} = rac{1}{2\pi \sqrt{LC}}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(\omega_0 = 1111.1 ext{ rad/s}\):
\[ u = rac{1111.1}{2 imes 3.1416} ext{ Hz} = rac{1111.1}{6.2832} ext{ Hz} \approx 176.84 ext{ Hz} \approx 176.8 ext{ Hz}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The natural frequency of free oscillations is \(176.8 ext{ Hz}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(L = 27.0 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H}\), \(C = 30.0 imes 10^{-6} ext{ F}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[ u = rac{\omega_0}{2\pi}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\(\omega_0 \approx 1111.1 ext{ rad/s}\)
\[ u = rac{1111.1}{2 imes 3.1416} \approx 176.8 ext{ Hz}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
प्राकृतिक आवृत्ति \(176.8 ext{ Hz}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q25 - Output voltage calculation for step-up transformer

questiontext.text:
An ideal transformer has \(100\) turns in its primary coil and \(200\) turns in its secondary coil. If an input voltage of \(220\text{ V}\) is applied across the primary coil, what is the output voltage across the secondary coil?

एक आदर्श ट्रांसफॉर्मर की प्राथमिक कुंडली में \(100\) फेरे और द्वितीयक कुंडली में \(200\) फेरे हैं। यदि प्राथमिक कुंडली पर \(220\text{ V}\) की निवेशी वोल्टता लगाई जाती है, तो द्वितीयक कुंडली पर निर्गत वोल्टता क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Primary turns \(N_p = 100\); Secondary turns \(N_s = 200\); Primary voltage \(V_p = 220\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For an ideal transformer, the voltage transformation ratio is:
\[\frac{V_s}{V_p} = \frac{N_s}{N_p}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[V_s = \left(\frac{N_s}{N_p}\right) V_p = \left(\frac{200}{100}\right) \times 220\text{ V} = 2 \times 220\text{ V} = 440\text{ V}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The output voltage is \(440\text{ V}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(N_p = 100\), \(N_s = 200\), \(V_p = 220\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[\frac{V_s}{V_p} = \frac{N_s}{N_p}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[V_s = \left(\frac{200}{100}\right) \times 220 = 440\text{ V}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
निर्गत वोल्टता \(440\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q26 - Series RC circuit impedance calculation at fifty hertz

questiontext.text:
A resistor of \(200\,\Omega\) and a capacitor of \(15.0\,\mu\text{F}\) are connected in series to a \(220\text{ V}\), \(50.0\text{ Hz}\) ac source. What is the total impedance \(Z\) of the circuit?

\(200\,\Omega\) का एक प्रतिरोधक और \(15.0\,\mu\text{F}\) का एक संधारित्र \(220\text{ V}\), \(50.0\text{ Hz}\) के ac स्रोत से श्रेणीक्रम में जुड़े हैं। परिपथ की कुल प्रतिबाधा \(Z\) क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Resistance \(R = 200\,\Omega\); Capacitance \(C = 15.0\,\mu ext{F} = 15.0 imes 10^{-6} ext{ F}\); Frequency \( u = 50.0 ext{ Hz}\); Voltage \(V = 220 ext{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
First determine capacitive reactance:
\[X_C = rac{1}{2\pi u C}\]
Then find the total impedance of the series \(RC\) combination:
\[Z = \sqrt{R^2 + X_C^2}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[X_C = rac{1}{2 imes 3.1416 imes 50.0 imes 15.0 imes 10^{-6}}\,\Omega = rac{10^6}{4712.4}\,\Omega \approx 212.2\,\Omega\]
Now substitute \(R\) and \(X_C\) into the impedance equation:
\[Z = \sqrt{(200)^2 + (212.2)^2} = \sqrt{40000 + 45028.8} = \sqrt{85028.8}\,\Omega \approx 291.6\,\Omega \approx 291.7\,\Omega\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The total circuit impedance is \(291.7\,\Omega\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(R = 200\,\Omega\), \(C = 15.0 imes 10^{-6} ext{ F}\), \( u = 50.0 ext{ Hz}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\(X_C = rac{1}{2\pi u C}\) तथा \(Z = \sqrt{R^2 + X_C^2}\)।

चरण 3: गणना
\[X_C = rac{1}{2 imes 3.1416 imes 50 imes 15 imes 10^{-6}} \approx 212.2\,\Omega\]
\[Z = \sqrt{200^2 + 212.2^2} = \sqrt{40000 + 45028.8} \approx 291.7\,\Omega\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
कुल प्रतिबाधा \(291.7\,\Omega\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q27 - Phasor calculation of source voltage in series RC

questiontext.text:
In a series \(RC\) circuit connected to an ac source, the measured rms voltage across the resistor is \(V_R = 151.0\text{ V}\) and the rms voltage across the capacitor is \(V_C = 160.3\text{ V}\). What is the rms voltage \(V\) of the source?

एक ac स्रोत से जुड़े श्रेणीबद्ध \(RC\) परिपथ में, प्रतिरोधक के सिरों पर मापी गई rms वोल्टता \(V_R = 151.0\text{ V}\) और संधारित्र के सिरों पर rms वोल्टता \(V_C = 160.3\text{ V}\) है। स्रोत की rms वोल्टता \(V\) क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(V_R = 151.0\text{ V}\), \(V_C = 160.3\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Because the voltage across the capacitor lags the current (and thus lags \(V_R\)) by \(90^\circ\), the source voltage must be calculated via phasor addition:
\[V = \sqrt{V_R^2 + V_C^2}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[V = \sqrt{(151.0\text{ V})^2 + (160.3\text{ V})^2} = \sqrt{22801 + 25696.09} = \sqrt{48497.09}\,\text{V} \approx 220.22\text{ V} \approx 220.0\text{ V}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The rms source voltage is \(220.0\text{ V}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(V_R = 151.0\text{ V}\), \(V_C = 160.3\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
फेजर योग द्वारा कुल वोल्टता:
\[V = \sqrt{V_R^2 + V_C^2}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[V = \sqrt{151.0^2 + 160.3^2} = \sqrt{22801 + 25696.09} \approx 220.0\text{ V}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
स्रोत की rms वोल्टता \(220.0\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q28 - Average power dissipated in series RC circuit

questiontext.text:
A resistor \(R = 200\,\Omega\) and a capacitor with capacitive reactance \(X_C = 212.3\,\Omega\) are connected in series across a \(220\text{ V}\) ac line. If the circuit current is \(I = 0.755\text{ A}\), what is the average power dissipated in the circuit?

एक प्रतिरोधक \(R = 200\,\Omega\) और धारितीय प्रतिघात \(X_C = 212.3\,\Omega\) वाला एक संधारित्र \(220\text{ V}\) की ac लाइन के सिरों पर श्रेणीक्रम में जुड़े हैं। यदि परिपथ धारा \(I = 0.755\text{ A}\) है, तो परिपथ में क्षयित औसत शक्ति क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(R = 200\,\Omega\); \(X_C = 212.3\,\Omega\); \(V = 220\text{ V}\); \(I = 0.755\text{ A}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
In an ac circuit, power is dissipated solely in the resistive component:
\[P = I^2 R = V I \cos\phi\]
where \(\cos\phi = \frac{R}{Z}\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
Using \(P = I^2 R\):
\[P = (0.755\text{ A})^2 \times 200\,\Omega = 0.570025 \times 200\text{ W} = 114.005\text{ W} \approx 114.0\text{ W}\]
Alternatively, with \(Z = \sqrt{200^2 + 212.3^2} \approx 291.7\,\Omega\):
\[\cos\phi = \frac{200}{291.7} \approx 0.6856\]
\[P = 220 \times 0.755 \times 0.6856 \approx 113.9\text{ W} \approx 114.0\text{ W}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The average power dissipated is \(114.0\text{ W}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(R = 200\,\Omega\), \(I = 0.755\text{ A}\), \(V = 220\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
शक्ति केवल प्रतिरोधक में क्षयित होती है:
\[P = I^2 R\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[P = (0.755)^2 \times 200 = 0.5700 \times 200 = 114.0\text{ W}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
क्षयित औसत शक्ति \(114.0\text{ W}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q29 - Series LCR circuit impedance calculation with three elements

questiontext.text:
A series \(LCR\) circuit has resistance \(R = 3.00\,\Omega\), self-inductance \(L = 25.48\text{ mH}\), and capacitance \(C = 796\,\mu\text{F}\), operated on a \(50.0\text{ Hz}\) alternating supply. What is the impedance \(Z\) of the circuit?

एक श्रेणीबद्ध \(LCR\) परिपथ में प्रतिरोध \(R = 3.00\,\Omega\), स्व-प्रेरकत्व \(L = 25.48\text{ mH}\) और धारिता \(C = 796\,\mu\text{F}\) है, जो \(50.0\text{ Hz}\) की प्रत्यावर्ती आपूर्ति पर संचालित है। परिपथ की प्रतिबाधा \(Z\) क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(R = 3.00\,\Omega\); \(L = 25.48 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H}\); \(C = 796 imes 10^{-6} ext{ F}\); \( u = 50.0 ext{ Hz}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Inductive reactance: \(X_L = 2\pi u L\).
Capacitive reactance: \(X_C = rac{1}{2\pi u C}\).
Impedance: \(Z = \sqrt{R^2 + (X_L - X_C)^2}\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[X_L = 2 imes 3.1416 imes 50.0 imes 25.48 imes 10^{-3} = 314.16 imes 0.02548 \approx 8.00\,\Omega\]
\[X_C = rac{1}{2 imes 3.1416 imes 50.0 imes 796 imes 10^{-6}} = rac{1}{0.25007} \approx 4.00\,\Omega\]
\[Z = \sqrt{(3.00)^2 + (8.00 - 4.00)^2} = \sqrt{9.00 + 16.00} = \sqrt{25.00} = 5.00\,\Omega\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The total circuit impedance is \(5.00\,\Omega\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(R = 3.00\,\Omega\), \(L = 25.48 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H}\), \(C = 796 imes 10^{-6} ext{ F}\), \( u = 50.0 ext{ Hz}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\(X_L = 2\pi u L\), \(X_C = rac{1}{2\pi u C}\), तथा \(Z = \sqrt{R^2 + (X_L - X_C)^2}\)।

चरण 3: गणना
\(X_L = 8.00\,\Omega\)
\(X_C = 4.00\,\Omega\)
\[Z = \sqrt{3.00^2 + (8.00 - 4.00)^2} = \sqrt{9 + 16} = 5.00\,\Omega\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
परिपथ की प्रतिबाधा \(5.00\,\Omega\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q30 - Phase angle calculation in series LCR circuit

questiontext.text:
A series \(LCR\) circuit has \(R = 3.0\,\Omega\), inductive reactance \(X_L = 8.0\,\Omega\), and capacitive reactance \(X_C = 4.0\,\Omega\). What is the phase difference \(\phi\) between the applied voltage and current?

एक श्रेणीबद्ध \(LCR\) परिपथ में \(R = 3.0\,\Omega\), प्रेरकीय प्रतिघात \(X_L = 8.0\,\Omega\) और धारितीय प्रतिघात \(X_C = 4.0\,\Omega\) है। प्रयुक्त वोल्टता और धारा के बीच कलान्तर \(\phi\) क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(R = 3.0\,\Omega\), \(X_L = 8.0\,\Omega\), \(X_C = 4.0\,\Omega\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The phase angle \(\phi\) by which current leads/lags voltage is given by:
\[\tan\phi = \frac{X_C - X_L}{R}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[\tan\phi = \frac{4.0\,\Omega - 8.0\,\Omega}{3.0\,\Omega} = -\frac{4.0}{3.0} \approx -1.333\]
\[\phi = \tan^{-1}(-1.333) = -53.13^\circ \approx -53.1^\circ\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The negative sign indicates that current lags the voltage by \(53.1^\circ\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(R = 3.0\,\Omega\), \(X_L = 8.0\,\Omega\), \(X_C = 4.0\,\Omega\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\[\tan\phi = \frac{X_C - X_L}{R}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[\tan\phi = \frac{4.0 - 8.0}{3.0} = -\frac{4}{3} \approx -1.333\]
\[\phi = -53.1^\circ\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
कलान्तर \(-53.1^\circ\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q31 - Power dissipated in series LCR circuit calculation

questiontext.text:
A sinusoidal voltage of peak value \(v_m = 283\text{ V}\) is applied to a series \(LCR\) circuit having impedance \(Z = 5.0\,\Omega\) and resistance \(R = 3.0\,\Omega\). What is the average power dissipated in the circuit?

प्रतिबाधा \(Z = 5.0\,\Omega\) और प्रतिरोध \(R = 3.0\,\Omega\) वाले एक श्रेणीबद्ध \(LCR\) परिपथ पर शिखर मान \(v_m = 283\text{ V}\) की एक ज्यावक्रीय वोल्टता लगाई जाती है। परिपथ में क्षयित औसत शक्ति क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(v_m = 283\text{ V}\); \(Z = 5.0\,\Omega\); \(R = 3.0\,\Omega\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Current amplitude: \(i_m = \frac{v_m}{Z}\).
RMS current: \(I = \frac{i_m}{\sqrt{2}}\).
Average power: \(P = I^2 R\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[i_m = \frac{283\text{ V}}{5.0\,\Omega} = 56.6\text{ A}\]
\[I = \frac{56.6\text{ A}}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{56.6}{1.414} = 40.0\text{ A}\]
\[P = (40.0\text{ A})^2 \times 3.0\,\Omega = 1600 \times 3.0\text{ W} = 4800\text{ W}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The average power dissipated in the circuit is \(4800\text{ W}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(v_m = 283\text{ V}\), \(Z = 5.0\,\Omega\), \(R = 3.0\,\Omega\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\(i_m = \frac{v_m}{Z}\), \(I = \frac{i_m}{\sqrt{2}}\), तथा \(P = I^2 R\)।

चरण 3: गणना
\(i_m = \frac{283}{5} = 56.6\text{ A}\)
\(I = \frac{56.6}{1.414} = 40\text{ A}\)
\[P = 40^2 \times 3 = 1600 \times 3 = 4800\text{ W}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
क्षयित औसत शक्ति \(4800\text{ W}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q32 - Resonant linear frequency of series LCR circuit

questiontext.text:
A series \(LCR\) circuit has \(L = 25.48\text{ mH}\), \(C = 796\,\mu\text{F}\), and \(R = 3.0\,\Omega\). What is the frequency \(\nu_r\) in hertz at which electrical resonance occurs?

एक श्रेणीबद्ध \(LCR\) परिपथ में \(L = 25.48\text{ mH}\), \(C = 796\,\mu\text{F}\) और \(R = 3.0\,\Omega\) है। हर्ट्ज़ में वह आवृत्ति \(\nu_r\) क्या है जिस पर वैद्युत अनुनाद होता है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(L = 25.48 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H}\); \(C = 796 imes 10^{-6} ext{ F}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Resonant angular frequency: \(\omega_0 = rac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}\).
Resonant frequency in hertz: \( u_r = rac{\omega_0}{2\pi}\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[LC = (25.48 imes 10^{-3}) imes (796 imes 10^{-6}) \approx 20.282 imes 10^{-6} ext{ s}^2\]
\[\sqrt{LC} \approx 4.5036 imes 10^{-3} ext{ s}\]
\[\omega_0 = rac{1}{4.5036 imes 10^{-3} ext{ s}} \approx 222.05 ext{ rad/s}\]
\[ u_r = rac{222.05}{2 imes 3.1416} ext{ Hz} = rac{222.05}{6.2832} ext{ Hz} \approx 35.34 ext{ Hz} \approx 35.4 ext{ Hz}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The resonant frequency is \(35.4 ext{ Hz}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(L = 25.48 imes 10^{-3} ext{ H}\), \(C = 796 imes 10^{-6} ext{ F}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\(\omega_0 = rac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}\) तथा \( u_r = rac{\omega_0}{2\pi}\)।

चरण 3: गणना
\(\omega_0 \approx 222.1 ext{ rad/s}\)
\[ u_r = rac{222.1}{2 imes 3.1416} \approx 35.4 ext{ Hz}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
अनुनादी आवृत्ति \(35.4 ext{ Hz}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q33 - Power dissipated at resonance in series LCR circuit

questiontext.text:
A series \(LCR\) circuit with \(R = 3.0\,\Omega\), \(L = 25.48\text{ mH}\), and \(C = 796\,\mu\text{F}\) is powered by a variable-frequency ac source of peak voltage \(v_m = 283\text{ V}\). When the source is tuned to the resonant frequency of the circuit, what is the power dissipated?

\(R = 3.0\,\Omega\), \(L = 25.48\text{ mH}\) और \(C = 796\,\mu\text{F}\) वाला एक श्रेणीबद्ध \(LCR\) परिपथ शिखर वोल्टता \(v_m = 283\text{ V}\) के एक परिवर्ती-आवृत्ति ac स्रोत द्वारा संचालित है। जब स्रोत को परिपथ की अनुनादी आवृत्ति पर समस्वरित किया जाता है, तो क्षयित शक्ति क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(R = 3.0\,\Omega\); Peak voltage \(v_m = 283\text{ V}\). Resonance condition: \(X_L = X_C\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
At resonance, impedance is minimum: \(Z = R\).
RMS source voltage: \(V = \frac{v_m}{\sqrt{2}}\).
RMS current at resonance: \(I = \frac{V}{R}\).
Power dissipated at resonance: \(P = I^2 R\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[V = \frac{283\text{ V}}{1.4142} \approx 200.1\text{ V}\]
\[I = \frac{200.1\text{ V}}{3.0\,\Omega} \approx 66.7\text{ A}\]
\[P = (66.7\text{ A})^2 \times 3.0\,\Omega = 4448.89 \times 3.0\text{ W} \approx 13347\text{ W} \approx 13.35\text{ kW}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The power dissipated at resonance is \(13.35\text{ kW}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(R = 3.0\,\Omega\), \(v_m = 283\text{ V}\)। अनुनाद की स्थिति।

चरण 2: सूत्र
अनुनाद पर \(Z = R\), \(V = \frac{v_m}{\sqrt{2}}\), \(I = \frac{V}{R}\), तथा \(P = I^2 R\)।

चरण 3: गणना
\(V \approx 200\text{ V}\)
\(I = \frac{200}{3} \approx 66.7\text{ A}\)
\[P = 66.7^2 \times 3 \approx 13350\text{ W} = 13.35\text{ kW}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
अनुनाद पर क्षयित शक्ति \(13.35\text{ kW}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q34 - Average power transferred at resonance in series LCR

questiontext.text:
A series \(LCR\) circuit with \(R = 20.0\,\Omega\), \(L = 1.50\text{ H}\), and \(C = 35.0\,\mu\text{F}\) is connected to a variable-frequency \(200\text{ V}\) rms ac source. When the source frequency matches the natural frequency of the circuit, what is the average power transferred over one complete cycle?

\(R = 20.0\,\Omega\), \(L = 1.50\text{ H}\) और \(C = 35.0\,\mu\text{F}\) वाला एक श्रेणीबद्ध \(LCR\) परिपथ एक परिवर्ती-आवृत्ति \(200\text{ V}\) rms ac स्रोत से जुड़ा है। जब स्रोत की आवृत्ति परिपथ की प्राकृतिक आवृत्ति के बराबर होती है, तो एक पूर्ण चक्र में स्थानांतरित औसत शक्ति क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(R = 20.0\,\Omega\); \(L = 1.50\text{ H}\); \(C = 35.0\,\mu\text{F}\); \(V = 200\text{ V}\). Circuit operating at resonance (\(\omega = \omega_0\)).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
At resonance, \(X_L = X_C\), so \(Z = R = 20.0\,\Omega\) and the power factor is \(\cos\phi = 1\). The power transferred is:
\[P = \frac{V^2}{R}\]

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[P = \frac{(200\text{ V})^2}{20.0\,\Omega} = \frac{40000}{20.0}\text{ W} = 2000\text{ W}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The average power transferred is \(2000\text{ W}\) (or \(2.0\text{ kW}\)).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(R = 20.0\,\Omega\), \(V = 200\text{ V}\)। अनुनाद की स्थिति में।

चरण 2: सूत्र
अनुनाद पर \(Z = R\) तथा \(\cos\phi = 1\):
\[P = \frac{V^2}{R}\]

चरण 3: गणना
\[P = \frac{200^2}{20} = \frac{40000}{20} = 2000\text{ W}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
स्थानांतरित औसत शक्ति \(2000\text{ W}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q35 - Resonant frequency and current amplitude in series LCR

questiontext.text:
A series \(LCR\) circuit has \(L = 5.00\text{ H}\), \(C = 80.0\,\mu\text{F}\), and \(R = 40.0\,\Omega\) connected across a variable-frequency \(230\text{ V}\) rms source. What are the resonant angular frequency \(\omega_0\) and the current amplitude \(i_m\) at resonance?

एक श्रेणीबद्ध \(LCR\) परिपथ में \(L = 5.00\text{ H}\), \(C = 80.0\,\mu\text{F}\) और \(R = 40.0\,\Omega\) हैं, जो एक परिवर्ती-आवृत्ति \(230\text{ V}\) rms स्रोत से जुड़े हैं। अनुनादी कोणीय आवृत्ति \(\omega_0\) और अनुनाद पर धारा का आयाम \(i_m\) क्या हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(L = 5.00\text{ H}\); \(C = 80.0\,\mu\text{F} = 80.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ F}\); \(R = 40.0\,\Omega\); \(V = 230\text{ V}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Resonant angular frequency: \(\omega_0 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}\).
Current amplitude at resonance: \(i_m = \frac{v_m}{R} = \frac{\sqrt{2} V}{R}\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[LC = 5.00 \times 80.0 \times 10^{-6} = 4.00 \times 10^{-4}\text{ s}^2\]
\[\sqrt{LC} = 2.00 \times 10^{-2}\text{ s}\]
\[\omega_0 = \frac{1}{2.00 \times 10^{-2}\text{ s}} = 50.0\text{ rad/s}\]
Voltage amplitude: \(v_m = \sqrt{2} \times 230\text{ V} \approx 325.27\text{ V}\).
Current amplitude:
\[i_m = \frac{325.27\text{ V}}{40.0\,\Omega} \approx 8.132\text{ A} \approx 8.13\text{ A}\]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The resonant angular frequency is \(50.0\text{ rad/s}\) and the current amplitude is \(8.13\text{ A}\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(L = 5.00\text{ H}\), \(C = 80.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ F}\), \(R = 40.0\,\Omega\), \(V = 230\text{ V}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\(\omega_0 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}\) तथा \(i_m = \frac{\sqrt{2} V}{R}\)।

चरण 3: गणना
\[\omega_0 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5.00 \times 80.0 \times 10^{-6}}} = \frac{1}{2.00 \times 10^{-2}} = 50.0\text{ rad/s}\]
\[i_m = \frac{\sqrt{2} \times 230}{40.0} \approx \frac{325.27}{40} \approx 8.13\text{ A}\]

चरण 4: अंतिम उत्तर
\(\omega_0 = 50.0\text{ rad/s}\) तथा \(i_m = 8.13\text{ A}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CH07_MCQ_Q36 - Inductor rms potential drop and circuit Q-factor

questiontext.text:
A series \(LCR\) circuit with \(L = 5.00\text{ H}\), \(C = 80.0\,\mu\text{F}\), and \(R = 40.0\,\Omega\) is driven at its resonating frequency (\(\omega_0 = 50.0\text{ rad/s}\)) by a \(230\text{ V}\) rms source. What are the rms potential drop across the inductor \(V_L\) and the Quality factor \(Q\) of the circuit?

\(L = 5.00\text{ H}\), \(C = 80.0\,\mu\text{F}\) और \(R = 40.0\,\Omega\) वाला एक श्रेणीबद्ध \(LCR\) परिपथ एक \(230\text{ V}\) rms स्रोत द्वारा अपनी अनुनादी आवृत्ति (\(\omega_0 = 50.0\text{ rad/s}\)) पर चालित है। प्रेरक के सिरों पर rms विभव पात \(V_L\) और परिपथ का विशेषता गुणांक \(Q\) क्या हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(L = 5.00\text{ H}\); \(C = 80.0\,\mu\text{F}\); \(R = 40.0\,\Omega\); \(V = 230\text{ V}\); \(\omega_0 = 50.0\text{ rad/s}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
RMS current at resonance: \(I = \frac{V}{R}\).
Inductive reactance: \(X_L = \omega_0 L\).
Voltage across inductor: \(V_L = I X_L\).
Quality factor: \(Q = \frac{\omega_0 L}{R} = \frac{V_L}{V}\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
\[I = \frac{230\text{ V}}{40.0\,\Omega} = 5.75\text{ A}\]
\[X_L = 50.0\text{ rad/s} \times 5.00\text{ H} = 250\,\Omega\]
\[V_L = 5.75\text{ A} \times 250\,\Omega = 1437.5\text{ V}\]
\[Q = \frac{\omega_0 L}{R} = \frac{250\,\Omega}{40.0\,\Omega} = 6.25\]
Check: \(Q = \frac{V_L}{V} = \frac{1437.5\text{ V}}{230\text{ V}} = 6.25\).

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The potential drop across the inductor is \(1437.5\text{ V}\) and the Quality factor is \(6.25\).

चरण 1: दिया गया डेटा
\(L = 5.00\text{ H}\), \(C = 80.0\,\mu\text{F}\), \(R = 40.0\,\Omega\), \(V = 230\text{ V}\), \(\omega_0 = 50.0\text{ rad/s}\)।

चरण 2: सूत्र
\(I = \frac{V}{R}\), \(X_L = \omega_0 L\), \(V_L = I X_L\), तथा \(Q = \frac{\omega_0 L}{R}\)।

चरण 3: गणना
\(I = \frac{230}{40} = 5.75\text{ A}\)
\(X_L = 50.0 \times 5.00 = 250\,\Omega\)
